title: TikTok Agrees to $400 Million Settlement in U.S. Child Privacy Lawsuit
contentSnippet:
The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) announced on Friday that ByteDance-owned TikTok will pay $400 million to settle a 2024 lawsuit accusing the company of violating child privacy laws in the country.

title: Hackers infect Android car head units with proxy botnet malware
contentSnippet: A supply-chain attack targeting Android-based car head units is using a legitimate device-update app to spread malware that enlists compromised devices in a proxy botnet or uses them for ad fraud. [...]

title: Named Pipes Under Attack: Securing Windows Interprocess Communication
contentSnippet: Windows named pipes provide fast interprocess communication, but weak access controls can expose privileged services to untrusted processes. ThreatLocker explains how endpoint verification, command authorization, strict input validation, and narrowly scoped privileges can help secure named-pipe communication. [...]

title: India-designed mobile phones likely in 10-14 months under MPMS; no place for copycats: Ashwini Vaishnaw
contentSnippet: "In this target segment of developing Indian brands, we are very particular that the design has to be your own design. It cannot just be a copycat. They have to come up with the design and prove that the IP is their own. We see three players who have the potential of coming up in a time frame of, let us say, about 10-14 months from now," Vaishnaw said.
